question:
The following bar graph shows the birthday months of 30 students of a class. How many students have their birthday during Jul-Nov?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29bcbef47569b4e80dde4c13d25f740853164d7e29c0c1d4d4fea98105b5c1cd.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Students have their birthday during Jul-Nov = 3 + 6 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 13

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
